This works nicely. When I clicked the **javascript** chip, the collection narrowed down to just the two links carrying that label — the MDN one and Eloquent JavaScript — and the counter updated to show two of four, with a little line telling me I'm looking at links labeled "javascript." That's exactly the payoff I wanted from labeling: click a label, see only those.

And having two ways to trigger it feels right, not redundant. Tapping the chip right on a bookmark is handy when I'm already looking at a link and think "show me more like this." The label row up top is nice for when I just want to jump straight to a category without hunting for a card first. Both make sense to me.

This filtering flow is good.
